videos.script: Ask pip how many packages are in your environment. {{freeze}} You installed seven. It says a hundred and three. {{hundred}} Every one of them can change the number your notebook prints. {{change}} Here is the same line of pandas, in two environments. One says object. The other says str. {{dtype}} Neither raises an error. {{silent}} This lesson writes the environment down, so it can be built again. A short file for what you asked for. A long one for everything you got. {{files}} Then it proves the file works, by building a second environment from it. {{prove}} It puts two environments in one JupyterLab, as two kernels. {{kernels}} And it installs conda, for the day a project needs something pip cannot give it. {{conda}} The first thing conda does is fail. That is worth seeing too. {{end}}
